definitions: A Japanese media franchise managed by The Pokémon Company, created by Satoshi Tajiri in 1996, centered on fictional creatures called "Pokémon", which humans, known as Pokémon Trainers, catch and train to battle each other for sport.
Any of the fictional creatures in the Pokémon franchise.
examples: I've been playing Pokémon since I was a kid.
The new Pokémon game is coming out next month.
